Average the individual Bytes / Milliseconds rates of each media type’s matching tracks.
Calculate rates using only tracks with non-null Bytes, but count all matching tracks.
Use only tracks with non-null Bytes for both rates and track counts.

Show only the media types whose rate is above the simple average of all media types' rates (each type counted once). For those, give the name, the rate, the track count, and how far the rate is above that average. Don't round anything. Use only tracks with non-null Bytes for both rates and track counts.
queries:
WITH media_rates AS (
    SELECT
        m.MediaTypeId,
        m.Name,
        1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate,
        COUNT(*) AS track_count
    FROM Track AS t
    JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
    GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId
),
average_rate AS (
    SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM media_rates
)
SELECT
    mr.Name,
    mr.rate,
    mr.track_count,
    mr.rate - ar.rate AS above_average
FROM media_rates AS mr
CROSS JOIN average_rate AS ar
WHERE mr.rate > ar.rate

WITH media_rates AS (
    SELECT
        m.Name,
        AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS rate,
        COUNT(*) AS track_count
    FROM Track AS t
    JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
    GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate
    FROM media_rates
)
SELECT
    mr.Name,
    mr.rate,
    mr.track_count,
    mr.rate - oa.average_rate AS above_average
FROM media_rates AS mr
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE mr.rate > oa.average_rate

WITH media_type_rates AS (
    SELECT
        m.Name,
        COUNT(*) AS track_count,
        1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) /
            SUM(CASE WHEN t.Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN t.Milliseconds END) AS rate
    FROM MediaType AS m
    JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
    GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId
),
average_rate AS (
    SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM media_type_rates
)
SELECT
    m.Name,
    m.rate,
    m.track_count,
    m.rate - a.rate AS above_average
FROM media_type_rates AS m
CROSS JOIN average_rate AS a
WHERE m.rate > a.rate

WITH media_type_rates AS (
    SELECT
        m.Name AS name,
        1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate,
        COUNT(*) AS track_count
    FROM Track AS t
    JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
    WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
),
average_rate AS (
    SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM media_type_rates
)
SELECT
    r.name,
    r.rate,
    r.track_count,
    r.rate - a.rate AS amount_above_average
FROM media_type_rates AS r
CROSS JOIN average_rate AS a
WHERE r.rate > a.rate;
